in_sanskrit.name: रुषिक्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Rushik is derived from the Sanskrit word रुषिक् (rusik), which means 'reddish', 'crimson', or 'ruddy'. This name is often used to describe someone with a reddish complexion or someone who is energetic and vibrant, just like the color red.

in_hindi.name: रुषिक
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Rushik in Hindi is रुषिक (rusik), which means 'having a reddish complexion'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word रुषिक् (rusik), which holds the same meaning. It is a beautiful and unique name for a baby boy.

in_tamil.name: ருஷிக்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name for Rushik is ருஷிக் (rushik). This name is derived from the Sanskrit word रुषिक् (rusik), which means 'reddish'. The Tamil meaning of Rushik is 'one who is lively and radiant like the color red'.

in_telugu.name: రుషిక్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name for Rushik is రుషిక్ (rushik). This name is derived from the Sanskrit word रुषिक् (rusik), which means 'reddish'. The Telugu meaning of Rushik is 'one who is energetic and full of life'.
